topics.label: Introduction to the Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture topic and frames the session's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen and Danger Recognition by Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the molecular mechanisms and receptor systems by which the innate immune system recognizes pathogens and cellular damage.

topics.label: Leukocyte Recruitment, Trafficking, and Inflammatory Responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sentinel cell activation drives leukocyte trafficking, local tissue extravasation, and systemic inflammatory responses.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how inflammation is resolved, how damaged tissue is repaired, and how unresolved inflammation leads to chronic disease and granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture Closing
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture and announces the topic of the next session.
